label: Inherited radical Chinese feminist rebellion against patriarchal family sacrifice
description: Growing up amid Qiu Jin’s Hunan-region revolutionary legacy, Ding Ling carried feminist militancy into modern psychological realism and socialist critique.
dialecticalTension: Shifts from late-Qing nationalist martyrdom to psychological and institutional gender critique.

label: Exposed how orthodox Communist practice in Yan’an reproduced patriarchal hypocrisy
description: Committed to socialist revolution, Ding Ling nonetheless indicted male party cadres in Thoughts on March 8 for punishing women whether they married or stayed independent.
dialecticalTension: Exposes the blind spot of class-reductionist Marxism toward gendered social reproduction.
